explanation.heading: Why this was flagged
explanation.text: A. Owusu committed code (payments-api) and deployed to production (svc-deploy-prod) 3 hours apart without a second approver. The commit and the deploy share one actor, and no second approval was recorded.

explanation.heading: Why it matters
explanation.text: The same actor commits code and changes production inside the window without another person approving the deploy. Our access control policy states it plainly: no one person may both change production code and deploy it to production without a second person approving the deploy.

paragraphs.heading: Control
paragraphs.text: Separation of duties: code and production. The same actor commits code and changes production inside the window without another person approving the deploy.

paragraphs.heading: Impact
paragraphs.text: Risk score 35 with severity high. Review due by Mar 2, 09:00. One person changed production without a second approval.

paragraphs.heading: Compensating controls
paragraphs.text: Record any compensating control and its evidence during review. The policy allows dual control or job rotation where separation is impractical.

paragraphs.heading: Remediation plan
paragraphs.text: Record the remediation steps and the evidence that shows them complete. Access control policy requires a second person approving any deploy to production.
